shared.dawn-store:dawn-style:
Cinematic still frame, 16:9, photographic realism.
A small Korean convenience store at 3 AM. Absolutely no people in frame.
Single light source: cool white ceiling fluorescent tubes, around 5000K.
Beyond the windows: deep navy night, no visible streetlights or signage.
Palette: cyan-white highlights, desaturated mid-tones, dark teal shadows. Low overall saturation.
Mood: quiet, still, faintly melancholic. Not horror. Nothing threatening.
Fine film grain. Shallow depth of field.
No text, no captions, no watermarks, no brand logos.
shared.day-walk:relight-prefix: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the attached neighborhood background. This is one frame for a web-app lighting crossfade: preserve the exact original 1672x941 aspect ratio and pixel-aligned framing, every roof outline, building, window, fence, tree, power line, road, bicycle and horizon at exactly the same positions and shapes. Do not repaint, crop, zoom, add/remove architecture or add text/UI. Only relight existing materials and sky. Premium stylized 3D animated-film rendering.

prompts.text:
Wide interior shot taken from just inside the entrance, at standing eye level.
On the right: an empty checkout counter, no clerk, register screen dark.
On the left: a hot-drink warmer cabinet holding canned coffee, its interior glowing faint amber.
Middle distance: a magazine rack against the wall.
Far right by the window: a narrow standing counter with a folded umbrella leaning against its leg.
The glass entrance door is at the far right edge of frame.
All four of these are visible in this single frame and clearly separated from each other.
Ceiling fluorescents reflect in long streaks on the polished floor.

meta.쓰이는 곳: intro 노드, 8초 정지 컷

prompts.text:
Exterior night shot, looking at the same convenience store from across an empty street.
The store windows glow bright white against a completely dark street; the store is the only lit thing in frame.
A faint silhouette of one person is reflected in the glass door, seen from behind, barely readable.
Damp asphalt in the foreground catching the store's light.
Camera at eye level, very slightly low angle.

meta.쓰이는 곳: coffee 노드, 14초

prompts.text:
Close-up of the top of the hot-drink warmer cabinet.
A single can of coffee sits on top of the cabinet, outside the warmer. No steam.
Beside it, a small crumpled paper receipt.
Focus on the can; the warmer's amber interior glows out of focus behind it.

meta.쓰이는 곳: back 노드, 4초 연결 컷

prompts.text:
Point of view walking down a narrow aisle between two shelving units of snacks and instant noodles.
The aisle leads back toward the checkout counter, visible small at the far end.
Ceiling fluorescents receding in one-point perspective.
Very slight motion blur at the frame edges.

meta.쓰이는 곳: magazine 노드, 42초

prompts.text:

One magazine is pulled slightly forward, out of alignment with the neat row beside it.
Its cover is sun-faded and washed out; the spine is visibly creased from being opened many times.
Focus on the misaligned one, the rest falling out of focus.

prompts.text:
Looking toward the glass entrance door from inside the store.
Through the glass the sky has shifted from navy to a pale blue-grey: the first light before sunrise.
The interior fluorescent light now reads weaker by comparison.
On the right side of frame stands a glass-door refrigerator cabinet.
Its glass clearly reflects part of the empty checkout counter behind the camera.
The reflection is legible, and no one is in it.

prompts.label: ① 새 디자인
prompts.text: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent two-frame horizontal sprite strip for a small bird companion in a polished 3D animated-film neighborhood web app. The attached neighborhood and girl are STYLE references only; DO NOT include girl, buildings, scenery, green background, text or UI in the output. Create one charming believable small songbird with soft slate-blue back and wings, warm ivory breast, tiny muted amber beak, dark glossy SMALL eyes, detailed soft layered feathers, warm sunlight on top and neutral soft fill. Rounded but proportionate, same high quality dimensional animated-film rendering as the references, not flat vector, not emoji, not a plastic toy, no white sticker outline. True transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard drawn, no floor or cast ground shadow. Output a 2:1 horizontal sprite sheet consisting of TWO equal square cells side by side, no borders or labels. Both cells show the SAME bird in right-facing three-quarter side view, tail left beak right, body level and flying, tiny feet tucked. Body, eye, beak and tail position and scale exactly identical relative to each cell. Cell 1: wings lifted upward in an elegant half-open upstroke. Cell 2: wings angled down in a gentle downstroke. Frame subject centered with generous transparent padding; wings and tail fully visible within own cell, no overlaps. Bird body occupies about 45 percent of each cell width, total bird silhouette about 78 percent. This sheet will animate as two frames at small size.

prompts.label: ② 배경을 초록으로 (최종)
prompts.text: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this exact two-frame bird sprite strip. Replace ONLY the entire checkerboard background with perfectly solid flat chroma-key GREEN RGB(0,255,0), hex #00FF00, including every gap between feather tips, tail and feet. It must be a single uniform green without any checkers, patterns, gradients, glow, texture, shadows, or floor. Preserve BOTH birds exactly in their two cells: identical positions, scale, feathers, colors and lighting. No green tint or spill on birds. Preserve exact 1774x887 canvas, no crop. This is a production chroma-key sprite sheet; the app will remove the solid green at rendering time. Two birds only, each fully within its original half, no text.
